reviews.text:
A huge thank you to Marion! She walked my dog ​​for seven days, and it was such a joy to have her with her. Marion does her job with heart: she's gentle, attentive, and exceptionally kind, and you can immediately tell that she genuinely loves animals. My dog ​​was thrilled every time she arrived, and that's the best proof of her kindness.

Honestly, she's exceptional. I highly recommend her, and I'll definitely use her services again!
Marion is very responsive and accommodating; she helped us out at the last minute by looking after our cat. This is the second time we've used her services, and we'll definitely do so again.

Marion is wonderful. She cat-sat for my cat. We received updates and photos every day, and my cat (who is quite shy) took to her immediately. Marion was a great listener and a very pleasant person. I recommend her without hesitation. Thank you! ✨

Dog sitting review 🐕😊:
We entrusted our furry friend to Marion for the weekend and everything went very well. Marion inspires confidence, the agreement is clear, but she really adapts to the dog's needs and the owners' requests (as much as possible, of course).
You can tell she genuinely enjoys visiting her little charges. Another big plus: excellent communication 👌🏻 Regular updates, photos, etc.! Everything is done to reassure us :)

I highly recommend her! ✨ Whenever I have a problem or a question, I can ask her for advice.

She always answers me kindly and gives excellent advice 😊

Don't miss out on her great advice!

We regularly use Marion's pet-sitting services for our cat Vicky (1-hour visits to our home when we're away, during which Marion takes care of feeding, watering, and playing with Vicky), and we are absolutely delighted. Vicky adores Marion, and we can go on vacation with complete peace of mind knowing she's in very good hands. We wholeheartedly recommend Marion and will continue to use her services!
Marion is a fantastic dog trainer. She listens carefully and is attentive to our dog's needs. We highly recommend her!

Marion looked after our Belgian Shepherd, Volko, for a three-day weekend when we couldn't take him. He's a very anxious dog, and his stay with her went wonderfully. He received lots of cuddles and long walks, she reassured him (and us too, by sending photos and messages), and we found him peaceful when we returned.

She also gave me some behavioral advice for a friend's dog, which proved very helpful.

Her passion for dogs, her gentleness, and her kindness truly make all the difference <3 I highly recommend her!
Marion was lovely and taught me so much about puppies! Little Mars thanks you for the time you spent with him :) I highly recommend Marion! In fact, that's what I do whenever friends adopt a pet :)
Summer thanks you for all the time you dedicated to her 😻 …

I heard about Marion through word of mouth, and I'm so lucky to have been told about her!

She's been taking such gentle care of my dog, Louve, for regular weekly walks for a while now. I've also used her services for a few sessions to work on some behavioral adjustments. All her invaluable advice has been so effective.
Marion is a great listener; you can tell she's passionate about her work and has a deep love for animals!
I can't thank her enough and recommend her without hesitation!

Thank you so much, Marion, for all your excellent advice!
If anyone is looking for a puppy trainer, I 100% recommend Marion.

Marion took excellent care of our cat Mikki. Thank you also for the very helpful advice.

I highly recommend her.

Marion is the perfect dog sitter! She takes care of Adibou with such gentleness and attention. He enjoys wonderful walks and he adores her, it's obvious!
Very kind, professional, and attentive, she knows exactly how to handle dogs. I recommend her without hesitation 🐾 …

I have a young Australian Shepherd/Serra Estrella mix dog who is sweet but very stubborn, making leash walking very difficult—she falls, etc. Thanks to Marion's patient and kind advice, walks on the leash have become a real pleasure. My dog ​​no longer pulls on the leash and doesn't make me fall.
It has changed my life with my dog. Pure bliss.

We wholeheartedly recommend Marion 🫶
We had an initial consultation with her followed by two training sessions with our 3-month-old puppy.
Aru adores her and was always thrilled to see her and work with her.
For us, it gave us valuable insights into exercises we could use with our puppy to teach him basic commands, recall, and "leave it alone," all through play!
A fantastic approach with plenty of helpful advice and genuine kindness!

I contacted Marion both to walk my dog ​​and to help me with some training, and I'm truly delighted with the experience.
The walks always went very well, with genuine respect for my dog's pace and needs. But above all, the training advice I received was clear and tailored to my dog's needs.
She's a professional, attentive, gentle person with animals, and a great teacher 😊
I recommend her without hesitation!

Boubou absolutely loved Marion! It was like I hadn't even left 🥲
Thank you for taking such good care of him! …

I've known Marion for several months now, and she's truly become a big part of our lives. She takes care of Una several times a week, and it's such a relief—and above all, a joy—knowing her is in her capable hands.

Marion is exceptional. She does her job with immense kindness, gentleness, and a genuine love for animals that's immediately apparent. Una is always thrilled to see her, and that says it all.

She's reliable, attentive, caring, and goes above and beyond what you'd expect. You can tell she's truly dedicated, with her whole heart.

I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for someone trustworthy to care for their pet.

She's the best with dogs, you can tell she loves them so much! My Vinnie isn't the easiest to walk, but she gave me excellent advice before I moved to Lyon. What a shame, I so wish she could have stayed in Eure-et-Loir 😭... …
